verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly supplies revised About-page titles, descriptions, technology highlights, mechanics copy, feature copy, and vision copy for rendering on the site.
The new prize amounts and draw frequencies necessarily replace the obsolete prize figures displayed in the About-page mechanics copy.
The source requests ebook-reader behavior and fiat-buyer FAQ content, not a change to the About page, and its fiat-specific prize description does not support a general About-page rewrite.
The client unambiguously accepts complete removal of Aave, requiring obsolete Aave references to be removed from the rendered About-page technology and feature lists.
Eliminating the Big Block mechanism necessarily removes its obsolete descriptions from the About-page mechanics copy while retaining the Small Block presentation.
The client requests site-wide prize and referral wording updates and less-hyped vision language, directly affecting rendered About-page mechanics and vision copy.
The source changes referral-code validation and popup feedback, not About-page content; it belongs to the referral-validation or mint-feedback Requirement.
The source reports expected commission and ticket accounting plus a runtime mismatch, not an About-page copy change.
The client accepts a first-mint accounting exception, but neither the acceptance nor its context requests that this edge case be added to the About page.

The client accepts that prize collection uses a conditionally displayed claim button, requiring the About-page reward-collection and automatic-reward copy to distinguish automatic commissions from conditional prize claiming.
